{{Quote|I am Seetoo Enntoo, steward of this vessel. It is my extreme good fortune to serve you.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC" />}}
'''C2-N2''' was a [[Hollis-series steward droid]] owned by the famous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]]. C2-N2 was assigned to the smuggler's [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] as its steward in [[3643 BBY]], and was responsible for maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and ensuring that the crew remained comfortable.
